meta.name: canvas
meta.description: Create spatial diagrams with free-positioned nodes using JSON format. Best for concept maps, knowledge graphs, and planning boards requiring precise x/y coordinate control.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用JSON自由摆放节点，创建空间关系图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要用精确坐标绘制概念图或知识图谱
copy.tagline_en: Create spatial diagrams with free-positioned nodes using JSON
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to draw concept maps or knowledge graphs with precise coordinate control

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以生成用 JSON 格式定义的空间关系图，如概念图、知识图谱或规划板。节点可自由放置，支持连线、颜色和分组。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 创建概念图、知识图谱或需要精确坐标布局的图表时触发。

say.text: 帮我画一个关于太阳系的概念图，包含行星和轨道。
say.note: Claude 会生成 JSON 格式的 canvas 代码。

say.text: 创建一个知识图谱，展示人工智能的主要分支。
say.note: Claude 会输出可渲染的 canvas 代码块。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate spatial diagrams defined in JSON format, such as concept maps, knowledge graphs, or planning boards. Nodes are freely positioned, with support for connections, colors, and grouping.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to create concept maps, knowledge graphs, or diagrams requiring precise coordinate layout.

say_en.text: Draw a concept map of the solar system with planets and orbits.
say_en.note: Claude will generate JSON canvas code.

say_en.text: Create a knowledge graph showing major branches of AI.
say_en.note: Claude will output a renderable canvas code block.
